## About
Wrecked LA Auto Body is a father and son shop on Chase St in Arleta. Sam spent years at a well known auto body shop in North Hollywood before he and his son Mike decided to start their own shop together. Sam has worked on all types of vehicles.
Having to fix your car can be a stressful time, so we try to make it as painless as possible. Whether you were in an accident, hit by vandalism or just picked up a door ding, we handle the repair in-house and work with your insurance company along the way.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 22 reviews on Google. One reviewer called us "an honest and straightforward family business," and that is exactly what we aim to be.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs after an accident, vandalism or a small door ding. We try to keep the whole process as painless as we can.
- Paint damage and rusting: One reviewer brought in a car with paint damage and rust on multiple panels and said it came back looking better than brand new.
- Side mirrors: One reviewer had a side mirror replaced after a run-in with some trash cans and said it looks perfect.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work directly with your insurance company to get you back into your car.

Q: Can you pick up my damaged car?
A: Yes. Give us a call and we will pick up your vehicle and help arrange a safe way home for you.

Q: What kind of damage do you fix?
A: Everything from accident damage and vandalism to small door dings.
